name: Daily BETA phase-matched momentum (long/short)
spec: At 18:00 regress each stock's previous-close -> 18:00 return on its ranked, lagged 252-day market beta. Long the 3 highest residuals in today's closing auction (exit next opening auction); short the 3 lowest at the next opening auction (exit that day's closing auction). 50/50 legs; skip longs up >= 9.4% and shorts opening <= -9.4%; 10 bp round trip.
deviations: Market factor for beta = equal-weight of the 48 names (original: BIST50 FF3 MKT).
18:00 price = close of the last 1-minute bar up to 17:59.
backtest_note: Backtest over Yahoo's 60-day 5-minute window (exact 18:00 price and auctions).
